posts.title: An excerpt from the letter a scientist at the Royal Energy Commission of Snezhnaya wrote to his dead father
posts.description: There's a lot I want to say to you. You're a good man, or you were, I know it. That's what Bàba told me; he said you had a good heart despite your cruelties. Is that true? Did you love me? You loved Bàba, I'm sure of that. I remember your voice from when I was very young, I remember it whispering Feofan, Fanya, Feofanushka. Azizam, joonam, nafasam. How could I forget? I remember it all - just very
